posts.author: Avery
posts.body:
Welcome to this year's advent calendar.
2020 has been hell of a ride and I hope you all can get some joy out of that event.
As every year I will post a daily resource until christmas, in the style of an advent calendar event. An advent calender is usually a box with 24 tiny doors, and behind each there is a surprise - usually candy.
My calender here is filled with all types of resources made for RMMZ.
This was a lot of work and while I enjoyed making it, I would be happy to hear your opinions, suggestions, thoughts and whatever you want to tell me. If you like something, let me know, if something is off, let me know as well. We all need those little uplifting things these days, and feedback is what makes my day.
I thought it would be fitting to start off the calendar with an entrance, so
Day 1: Stone door
What could lie behind these doors? A temple? A dungeon?
Did we have to cast a spell to open it? Or pull a hidden trigger?
The giant stone door comes with 3 different opening animations and can be used whereever you feel it fits - though I guess there is some fantasy stuff involved, if we talk about giant stone doors, right? ;3

In my home country, the 24th is where the main event of christmas happens, and it traditionally is the day an advent calendar ends with (actually, an advent calendar was invented to shorten the time till christmas for the kids).
So, as with today, the event is over and I hope you all had a good time.
My advent was rough, to keep it simple and I am glad I prepared this cause there is no way I could've handled it without that. Let us all hope 2021 is better than 2020.
So, it is now the 24th here, which means
Day 24: Giant Dragon
I was really nervous about this, because after all, it is "just a single char". But oof, it took forever.
After having that fairylike MV dragon i was kinda happy to get a regular dragon back in MZ, but... I don't wanna sound picky or anything, but I am not into those extra mean buff dragons.
And I really think we need a full dragon sprite, not just the front. So my first thought was to make a 4-directional sprite of the buff dragon, but nah... and then I saw that tiny tiny dragon on the vehicles. And I loved the design!
The only problem was that is was so tiny!
So...
I upscaled it. And to everyone who is like "Aha, you can upscale pixel art and it looks nice and high resolution!"
Well, sure, if you spend the uncounted hours to reconstruct how that dragon could look like if it was larger. And this one is now even bigger than the boss monster dragon :3
I would say, that one sprite took longer than all the trees for the forest set. And I really hope it was worth it.
So thank you everybody who followed and interacted with my posts over the calendar. I wish I had more time to answer all comments, but life was really not nice to me lately. I read and enjoyed all your comments though!
So, now that we are done, I have some questions:
What is your favourite item in the calendar?
And which themes of the calendar would you like to see revisited and expanded in the future?

In 1793, on this date, the Reign of Terror started as part of the events of the French Revolution. in 1877, the native American tribal leader Crazy Horse died (allegedly, depending wheater he survived the stabbing past midnight). In 1992 something happened that might have affected some of your maker games. Maybe. Possibly. Whatever.
As annual celebration, I release something on this date, and here we go!
I think my biggest disappointment in MV is over the dungeon autotiles and though there are some raw nuggets in there, it takes a lot of edits to make the ground look like I like it. For the walls I gave up editing and drew them completly from scratch.
The waterfall is darkened to look more like an actual lava flow and I added a upper and lower rim, for some softer transitions (lava does not splash like water as far as I know).
I am very happy with the outcome, and though the default B and C tiles do not have massive amounts of variation, I think you can now make very very pretty caves, if you like
The preview maps are maker shots, so completly possible with using the layers.

Today on day
23
I have something very special, I set that I both love and worry about, as it is much less plug and play then anything else from the calendar...
This giant sheet with plenty of pieces is a modular key/earring/necklace/medal/collar set with 26 different charms to attatch to them. The possibilities are endless, especially since you can also tack two different charms on the same set of earrings if you like...
How to use it:
Open it for example in Gimp and pick the two colors you like and merge them by copy and paste
Then pick a charm and a base and merge them by copy and paste
If you have trouble to get the right position, you can use a snapping 8x8 grid, this will allow all the possible positions for the charms.
And now... well, go ahead, have fun!
Here is a handful of random combinations I just made as examples!
No matter if you want to go full resident evil on the keys, need to equip a feline or canine party member, want some nice extra accessoirs, need jewlery for a quest or want to use medals instead of necklaces as accessoirs on your paladin... the possibilities are endless!
And feel free to post your favourite combination in the thread here (I know, usually no repost, but I'd like to see which is your favourite!)
